additional_info.subject: ID0467748-DC/Si-D/NL-[MP / S7 170003820] Disconnect of LEM and payment terminal CRM:00315003105
additional_info.body:
Hi Peter, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
In the case of the LEM I believe it can be a simple Ethernet cable issue, since it's "toggling". I would start from here, try to replace the cable or try to get the Ethernet cable from the other LEM to this one.
What we want to make sure here is to prove whether the fault is on the LEM or the Ethernet cable.
Another thing you can try is swapping the Switch port of XF1, maybe the port is not good and you can use a spare one or even swap with the other LEM port.
For the Payment Terminal we should try the same thing, I believe in the terminal we should be able to see if there is any error but remotely it's not possible since i cannot reach it.
Please start by checking the Ethernet cable to XF4and if all the connections of 24V and such are properly inserted and providing the nominal value.
If everything fails, we might need to replace it.
When going to site, I recommend taking a spare Payment Terminal but the LEM meter, in my opinion, looks like a cable issue.
I will forward this ticket to the RC-NL queue, if you need support on site, please reach out to me directly via Teams or add me in this trend, at least with 1 day in advance.
Thank you very much and have a lovely holidays.
Best regards,
Francisco
